tours.title: Phnom Penh Full-Day City Highlights Tour
tours.short_description: Explore the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, National Museum, Tuol Sleng (S-21), and Choeung Ek Killing Fields with an English-speaking driver.
tours.description: An essential full-day cultural and historical immersion through Cambodia's capital. Travel comfortably between iconic landmarks with air-conditioned breaks, cold water, and insightful historical context.

tours.title: Angkor Wat Sunrise & Grand Circuit Temple Tour
tours.short_description: Experience magical dawn over Angkor Wat, Bayon smiling stone faces, Ta Prohm jungle temple, and Banteay Srei with private driver flexibility.

destinations.name: Phnom Penh
destinations.short_description: Cambodia's bustling riverside capital rich with gilded royal palaces, vibrant markets, and deeply poignant history.
destinations.description: Phnom Penh sits at the junction of the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers. Famous for the Royal Palace, Silver Pagoda, bustling Sisowath Quay riverside, vibrant cafes, and historical monuments including Tuol Sleng and Choeung Ek.
destinations.travel_tips: Airport is ~45 mins from center. Private taxi is easiest to navigate city traffic with luggage.

destinations.name: Siem Reap (Angkor Wat)
destinations.short_description: The world-famous gateway to Angkor Archaeological Park, floating villages, vibrant night markets, and Khmer hospitality.
destinations.description: Siem Reap is world-renowned for the magnificent 12th-century Angkor Wat temple complex, mysterious smiling faces of Bayon, jungle-entangled Ta Prohm, and cultural boat excursions across Tonle Sap lake.
destinations.travel_tips: The new SAI Airport is 45km away (~1 hr drive). Book airport taxi in advance to avoid long waits.

destinations.name: Kampot & Kep
destinations.short_description: Riverside French colonial tranquility, mountain breezes, world-famous organic pepper farms, and seaside crab delicacies.
destinations.description: Nestled between the Elephant Mountains and the ocean, Kampot and Kep offer relaxing riverside sunsets, Bokor National Park adventures, organic pepper plantations, and oceanfront dining.
destinations.travel_tips: Approx. 3 hours from Phnom Penh. Private overland taxi is the most scenic way to arrive.

destinations.name: Sihanoukville & Koh Rong
destinations.short_description: Coastal hub and gateway to pristine white sand tropical islands of Koh Rong and Koh Rong Sanloem via modern expressway.
destinations.description: Connected directly to Phnom Penh in under 3 hours via the new expressway, Sihanoukville is the main launch point for ferry transfers to turquoise island paradises.
destinations.travel_tips: Take private taxi straight to the ferry pier for hassle-free island connection.

faqs.question: How do airport pickups work? Where will the driver meet me?
faqs.answer: For all airport arrivals (Phnom Penh PNH or Siem Reap SAI), our driver tracks your flight number in real time. After you collect your luggage and exit the customs arrival gate, your assigned driver will be waiting inside the arrival hall holding a clear sign with your name. You never have to worry about flight delays.

faqs.question: Are your prices fixed, or will there be extra fees for highway tolls or parking?
faqs.answer: All quoted prices are 100% fixed and transparent. They include the private air-conditioned vehicle, fuel, driver fee, expressway tolls, airport parking fees, and cold bottled water. There are never surprise meter charges or hidden fees.

faqs.question: How and when do I pay for my ride?
faqs.answer: Payment is made directly to your driver in cash (USD or Cambodian Riel) upon safely arriving at your destination. No advance credit card deposit is required for standard airport and city transfers.

faqs.question: Can we stop for coffee, restrooms, or photos during an overland trip?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely! Since this is a 100% private transfer, you have complete control over stops. Your driver will gladly stop at clean roadside service centers, coffee shops, or scenic spots whenever you wish.

faqs.question: Do your drivers speak English?
faqs.answer: Yes! All our drivers speak communicative, professional English. Communicating trip details, itinerary preferences, meeting points, and travel recommendations is effortless.

faqs.question: What vehicles are available for larger families or groups with heavy luggage?
faqs.answer: We offer Comfort Sedans (1–3 pax), Spacious SUVs (1–4 pax), and Executive Minivans (Toyota Alphard / HiAce for up to 10 pax with extra large luggage compartments). All vehicles feature high-output air conditioning.
